items.title: Stryker (SYK) Keeps Knee Robot Production In The US And Expands Robotic Surgery
items.summary: Stryker (NYSE:SYK) is keeping manufacturing of its knee surgery robots in the U.S., according to comments from the CEO. Management cited intellectual property protection as the key reason for concentrating production of the robotic knee systems in domestic facilities. The medical technology group is also investing in soft-tissue robotic surgery through a new partnership with CMR Surgical, including U.S. distribution rights.
